206:t_2:11.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That our life until now couldn't last forever...」

206:t_2:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That someday the enemy would come, wreck everything, and take me away...」

206:t_2:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If I'd gone with him... with $$レナード$$, $$恭子$$ and everyone wouldn't have been caught up in this...」

206:t_2:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's all my fault... I'm to blame...」

206:t_2:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's wrong. The enemy is to blame.」

206:t_2:18.en:
$$宗介$$
「And everyone is still safe. If we rescue them, it'll be all right.」

206:t_2:19.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Rescue them? There's no way to do that, however you look at it!」

206:t_2:21.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What are you saying? Are you an idiot? Everyone at school is being held hostage!」

206:t_2:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's not just $$恭子$$. Professionals have carefully hidden bombs all over the school, right? We'll never find them...」

206:t_2:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「If we had the proper electronic equipment... an AS, we could trace the detonator's radio signal...」

206:t_2:26.en:
$$かなめ$$
「With equipment at the enemy's level, they'd send signals using communications that are hard to detect.」

206:t_2:27.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Of course they'll be watching the area around the school. Even an AS using $$ＥＣＳ$$ couldn't get close.」

206:t_2:28.en:
$$かなめ$$
「They could easily have wide-area molecular spectrum sensors, interference direction-finding microphones, and sensitive magnetic sensors, right?」

206:t_2:29.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Even if we locate the bombs, do you think we can disarm them? We couldn't even examine what's inside.」

206:t_2:30.en:
$$かなめ$$
「They could make any number of mechanisms that react to nuclear magnetic resonance. Don't you even understand something that simple?」

206:t_2:31.en:
$$宗介$$
「...$$千鳥$$... I'm sorry. I don't understand what you're saying...」

206:t_2:33.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I see... So you're the same after all.」

206:t_2:35.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What's that look? Do you think there's something wrong with my head?」

206:t_2:36.en:
$$宗介$$
「I didn't say that. But you...」

206:t_2:37.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yes, that's right. He was right.」

206:t_2:38.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It irritates me. When you make that stupid face, I feel as if you're mocking me.」

206:t_2:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Every last one of you! Why can't you understand something so simple? Are you stupid?」

206:t_2:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's only an illusion you feel because your $$ウィスパード$$ ability has raised your intelligence beyond ordinary people.」

206:t_2:42.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't look down on others. Admit you're ill. Remember, you always...」

206:t_2:43.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...By looking concerned, you give yourself a psychological advantage...」

206:t_2:44.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Do you think that sham concern will put you in control? You're simple-minded.」

206:t_2:45.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Earlier, you said this. That you're afraid of me. You like me, but you're afraid.」

206:t_2:47.en:
$$宗介$$
「I feel the same. I like you.」

206:t_2:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「But I'm afraid... I don't understand you... Yet I'm drawn to you...」

206:t_2:49.en:
$$宗介$$
「It keeps repeating. Ever since we first met. I've never felt anything like this before.」

206:t_2:50.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're the one who changed my entire world.」

206:t_2:51.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll... protect everything. Not just you. I'll guard the whole world that belongs to you.」

206:t_2:54.en:
$$宗介$$
「Help me rescue $$常磐$$ and everyone else. We'll make it work, just as we always have.」

206:t_2:55.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Do you really think you can save everything?」

206:t_2:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「Affirmative. If you and I work together.」

206:t_2:58.en:
$$かなめ$$
「In a cheap novel, this would be the moving kiss scene. But...」

206:t_2:63.en:
$$宗介$$
「...You're probably right. I know it's pointless for a slow-witted man like me to argue with you.」

206:t_2:64.en:
$$宗介$$
「But I want to save you... And the people you care about too.」

206:t_2:65.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The chance of doing that isn't even one percent.」

206:t_2:66.en:
$$宗介$$
「...If I can save you, I don't care what happens to the world...」

206:t_2:67.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'd do anything... rather than hand you over to them...」

206:t_2:69.en:
$$宗介$$
「...It's a stun gun. I'm sorry, $$千鳥$$...」

206:t_2:71.en:
$$宗介$$
「If $$アル$$ were here, I'm sure he'd call it irrational...」

206:t_2:72.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$... You probably won't forgive me for making this choice.)

206:t_2:73.en:
$$宗介$$
(But this is the only... the only way I can think of...)

206:t_2:74.en:
$$宗介$$
(I'll keep my promise... I'll guard everything that belongs to you.)

206:t_2:75.en:
$$宗介$$
(I have no allies here, but I have to do it...! If there's even a one-percent chance, I'll gamble on it!)

206:t_3:3.en: ～$$陣代高校$$　Old Building　Empty Classroom～

206:t_3:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「I've disarmed the explosives on your body too. You're safe now.」

206:t_3:8.en:
$$恭子$$
「I don't understand... What's going on...?」

206:t_3:9.en:
$$恭子$$
「People with guns suddenly attacked me and shoved me in here...!」

206:t_3:11.en:
$$恭子$$
「...I think I get it. Someone's after $$カナ$$, aren't they?」

206:t_3:12.en:
$$恭子$$
「That's why everyone got caught up in danger on the school trip...」

206:t_3:14.en:
$$恭子$$
「Then why didn't $$カナ$$... tell me a single thing?! I thought I was her best friend!」

206:t_3:16.en:
$$恭子$$
「You know about it, don't you...」

206:t_3:17.en:
$$恭子$$
「Only you and $$カナ$$ know? Weren't we friends?」
